title: Iran conflict z>2 -> DHT +2d
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Iran-Gulf dyad event count 15d z-score > 2 leads DHT log returns by 2 days (+); trade long DHT 4d [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.DHT.log_return]
message: Not supported at lag 2 (r=-0.033, n=390, best lag 6 r=-0.082); z>1 long-DHT 6d rule shows 28 trades, hit 64%, excess 0.34%, actionability 8.69 - likely war common-cause.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long DHT next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 6 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Iran conflict event 20d z-score > 1 leads DHT log returns by 1 day (+), null control: same rule on XLE should show weaker edge; trade long DHT 6d [gdelt.irn.conflict_events -> finance.DHT.log_return] (parent: R2-0004)
